page.overview:
Who is Bobby Socks?

Bobby Socks is a teenaged halfling druid and a member of the Glorious Ones, a small group of adventurers. He was played by Taliesin Jaffe in .

Bobby is something of a late bloomer, even for a halfling, appearing younger than his actual age. He has messy brown hair and was wearing brown boots and gloves with green short pants and a shirt covered by a small leather tunic. He wore a little backpack and carried a belt pack of cards.

Bobby was bubbly and excited by everything happening around him, and the polar opposite of "cool". Despite his father Kent Plucker being obviously disinterested and slightly disparaging of him, he persisted in seeing their relationship in the best way possible and imagining it to be closer than it apparently was.

Bobby is the child of Kent Plucker, a bard and member of Dr. Dranzel's Spectacular Traveling Troupe. He apparently spends most of his time with his mother, visiting his disinterested father on rare occasions.
